metadata.title: ENOLA numerical and experimental propeller database
metadata.description:
This dataset contains experimental measurements and numerical results of different propeller geometries. The dataset is developed in the context of project ENOLA. 
 
There is a "GeneralInfo" Excel file listing the propellers for which data is available, along with the specific data (experimental measurements, numerical results, simulations, etc.) provided for each one.
 
The propellers are grouped in "Families" of related propellers. Inside each propeller folder, a README explaining the existing data can be found. Data is divided into two categories:
  • Results: Experimental measurements and results from numerical simulations are provided. The possible results may include forces, moments, and acoustic emissions under different conditions.
  • Geometry: Geometry data of the propeller is provided when available. This may include CAD geometry, twist and chord distribution, airfoils used, etc.
